Title: Annihilation [Ritual, Limited]
Name: Annihilation
Effect: This Ritual instantly slays the target and causes them to receive two(2) additional deaths. The effects of this Ritual are negated if the target receives a Life Spell before Dissipating. This Ritual is always Unstable, takes one hour to cast and has a 10% Chance to Succeed, a 60% Chance to Flaw, a 20% Chance to Fail, and a 10% chance to Backlash. If this Ritual Backlashes, roll on the Catastrophe table.

Title: Blood Drinker [Ritual]*
Name: Blood Drinker
Effect: This Ritual imbues the target weapon with the following ability. Once per Reset, the wielder of this Weapon may use it to deliver an attack causing "20 Physical-Strike Body".

Title: Channel Poison [Ritual]*
Name: Channel Poison
Effect: At the time of this Ritual's casting the Caster chooses a single Alchemy, they can cast, with a range of Packet. Whenever the wielder casts the chosen Alchemy they may use this Weapon to deliver the effect as <Effect>-Strike. The Delivery Type of the attack changes to match that of the Channelled Alchemy.

Title: Channel Spell [Ritual]*
Name: Channel Spell
Effect: At the time of this Ritual's casting the Caster chooses a single Spell , they can cast, with a range of Packet. This Ritual imbues the target weapon with the following ability. Whenever the wielder casts the chosen Spell they may alter the Delivery Type to <Effect>-Strike. The Delivery Type of the attack changes to match that of the Channelled Spell.

Title: Cleaving Weapon [Ritual]*
Name: Cleaving Weapon
Effect: This Ritual imbues the target weapon with the following ability. Once per Reset, the wielder of this Weapon may use it to Echo a single Martial Art which they have just Cast from memory. The Echoed Martial Art includes all the same options, modifications, including effects from Katas and Martial Traditions, which were applied to the original Martial Art. The decision to use this ability must be made within ten(10) seconds of the original being delivered. The call for this ability is "Echo <Delivery Verbal>".

Title: Corruption Bane [Ritual]*
Name: Corruption Bane
Effect: This Ritual imbues the target weapon with the following ability. Once per Reset, the wielder of this Weapon may use it to deliver a "Physical-Strike Vanquish Abomination".

Title: Create Alchemical Fountain [Ritual]*
Name: Create Alchemical Fountain
Effect:
This Ritual transforms the target Circle into a Protective Circle of one of the following types; Creation: The Power Component cost of any Ritual Alchemy cast in this Circle is reduced by one(1) to a minimum of one(1). Knowledge: Anyone invested may Identify any Alchemy effect within the Circle. Vorpal Font: Anyone invested may spend a three(3)- count to grant themselves the effects of a "Poison Vorpal 5".

 Anyone in the Circle for the casting gains an Investiture into the Circle allowing them to enter or leave at will as well as allowing others to do so. Any creature inside of the Circle is Immune to all effects which originate from outside it.

 Multiple castings of this Ritual on the same Circle can be done. Each additional casting grants the target Circle one additional functions outlined above and grants the Circle a Ward against the next Break or Destroy Magic effect by which it is targeted. These Wards are replenished at the end of the Day.

Title: Create Bane [Ritual, Limited]
Name: Create Bane
Effect: This Ritual creates a Bane of the type specified by the Scroll. When used to deliver a Killing Blow, the Bane causes the creature to immediately die and seek Resurrection. Banes have additional effects based on the Scroll. Eg. Bane of Vampires: 1/Ever Arcane Solidify

Title: Create Forge of Kings [Ritual]*
Name: Create Forge of Kings
Effect:
This Ritual transforms the target Circle into a Protective Circle of one of the following types; Creation: The Power Component cost of any Ritual Smithing cast in this Circle is reduced by one(1) to a minimum of one(1). Honing: Any Character who is invested in the Circle may spend one(1) minute to sharpen a single weapon granting them the effects of the Invocation Hone Weapon. Knowledge: Anyone invested may Identify any Smithing effect within the Circle.

 Anyone in the Circle for the casting gains an Investiture into the Circle allowing them to enter or leave at will as well as allowing others to do so. Any creature inside of the Circle is Immune to all effects which originate from outside it.

 Multiple castings of this Ritual on the same Circle can be done. Each additional casting grants the target Circle one additional functions outlined above and grants the Circle a Ward against the next Break or Destroy Magic effect by which it is targeted. These Wards are replenished at the end of the Day.

Title: Create Golem [Ritual, Limited]
Name: Create Golem
Effect:
This Ritual creates a Golem of the type specified by the Scroll.

 The Golem is bound to perform a single Service and a number of additional Services based on the number of Casters participating in the casting. For every five(5) Casters participating, rounded down, the number of services may be increased by one(1) to a maximum of five(5) total Services.

 As Golems are mindless, they are only able to perform simple Services such as "Defend me,", "Follow me and search every creature I kill." or "Guard this area.". Invalid Services are ones which require Sentience such as "Travel to the town of Glenn and count how many foreign soldiers are there.". The maximum time a Service can take is one(1) hour.

Title: Create Homunculus [Ritual, Limited]
Name: Create Homunculus
Effect:
This Ritual creates a creature of the type specified by the Scroll to perform one(1) or more services for the Primary Caster.

 The power and number of services performed by the creature is determined by the number of Casters participating in the casting. For every three(3) Casters participating, rounded down, the power or number of services may be increased by one(1) to a maximum of five(5) in either category. For example six Casters could increase the power to two(2) and the number of services to two(2). Alternatively they could increase the power to three(3) and have only the one(1) service provided by the base effect.

 A Service is a single finite task. The maximum time a Service can take is one(1) hour. Examples of valid Services are; "Follow and protect me on this adventure.", "Go to the town of Exampleton and tell me how many soldiers are there.", "Aid me with the casting of this Ritual.". Examples of invalid Services are; "Guard this area forever.", "Stay in this Circle and help us cast all our Rituals.", "Explore all the camps of the foreign military and bring me a list of all commanders.".

Title: Create Magic Circle [Ritual]*
Name: Create Magic Circle
Effect:
This Ritual transforms the target Circle into a Protective Circle of one of the following types; Binding: The number of Services provided by any creature Summoned into this Circle is increased by one(1). Creation: The Power Component cost of any Ritual Magic cast in this Circle is reduced by one(1) to a minimum of one(1). Knowledge: Anyone invested may Identify any magical effect within the Circle. Resurrection: Anyone invested may Resurrect a dead character whose spirit has travelled to the Circle.

 Anyone in the Circle for the casting gains an Investiture into the Circle allowing them to enter or leave at will as well as allowing others to do so. Any creature inside of the Circle is Immune to all effects which originate from outside it.

 Multiple castings of this Ritual on the same Circle can be done. Each additional casting grants the target Circle one additional functions outlined above and grants the Circle a Ward against the next Break or Destroy Magic effect by which it is targeted. These Wards are replenished at the end of the Day.

Title: Create Undead [Ritual, Limited]
Name: Create Undead
Effect:
This Ritual creates an Undead of the type specified by the Scroll.

 Mindless Undead are bound to perform a single Service and a number of additional Services based on the number of Casters participating in the casting. For every three(3) Casters participating, rounded down, the number of services may be increased by one(1) to a maximum of five(5) total Services.

 Mindless Undead are only able to perform simple Services such as "Defend me,", "Follow me and search every creature I kill." or "Guard this area.". Invalid Services are ones which require Sentience such as "Travel to the town of Glenn and count how many foreign soldiers are there.". The maximum time a Service can take is one(1) hour.

 Intelligent Undead are bound to perform a single Service and a number of additional Services based on the number of Casters participating in the casting. For every five(5) Casters participating, rounded down, the number of services may be increased by one(1) to a maximum of five(5) total Services.

 A Service is a single finite task. The maximum time a Service can take is one(1) hour. Examples of valid Services are; "Follow and protect me on this adventure.", "Go to the town of Exampleton and tell me how many soldiers are there.", "Aid me with the casting of this Ritual.". Examples of invalid Services are; "Guard this area forever.", "Stay in this Circle and help us cast all our Rituals.", "Explore all the camps of the foreign military and bring me a list of all commanders.".

Title: Crushing Blow [Ritual]*
Name: Crushing Blow
Effect: This Ritual imbues the target weapon with the following ability. Once per Reset, the wielder of this Weapon may use it to deliver an attack causing "20 Physical-Strike Force".

Title: Delve History [Ritual]
Name: Delve History
Effect: This Ritual reveals, to the casters, details about the past of the target item. The nature and scope of the information is determined by Plot.

Title: Destroy Magic [Ritual]
Name: Destroy Magic
Effect: This Ritual Destroys all magic, including Ritual Magic, in effect upon the target.

Title: Duplicate Scroll [Ritual]
Name: Duplicate Scroll
Cost: P2 C1 E1 T1 + See Text
Effect:
This Ritual effect allows the Caster to create a duplicate of the target Ritual Scroll. As an additional cost to cast this Ritual the Caster must include additional components equal to the full Component cost of the Ritual effect being copied. Skills and effects which reduce the number of components needed to cast a Ritual cannot reduce the number of Components needed for this additional cost.

 When performed as a Ritual Magic effect this Ritual must target a Ritual Magic Scroll and creates a Ritual Magic Scroll. When cast as a Ritual Alchemy effect it targets and creates a Ritual Alchemy Formula. Ritual Smithing targets and creates a Ritual Smithing Schematic.

Title: Echoing Quiver [Ritual]*
Name: Echoing Quiver
Effect: This Ritual imbues the target Quiver with the following ability. Once per Reset, the wielder may Echo a single Martial Art delivered by one, or more, Archery Packet(s). The Call for this ability is "Echo <Delivery Verbal>"

Title: Elemental Weapon [Ritual]*
Name: Elemental Weapon
Effect: As part of Casting this Ritual the caster chooses one of the following Damage Types;  Chaos, Destruction, Dream, Essence, Fire, Ice, Light, Lightning, Order, Reason, Shadow, or Stone. The wielder of the target Weapon may use the chosen Damage Type in addition to the Weapon's normal Weapon Type. Additionally, when using an <Effect>- Strike which uses the Weapon's Weapon Type, they may instead replace the Weapon Type with the Chosen Damage Type.

Title: Elixir of Lies [Ritual, Limited]
Name: Elixir of Lies
Effect:
This effect creates a special elixir which renders its imbiber into a brief, but highly suggestible state. Once consumed, the effects of this Ritual take effect on the imbiber as follows; The target immediately forgets all events which have occurred in the last hour. The Caster may describe, in ten(10) words or fewer, an alternate memory. If the Caster describes an alternate memory the target will believe it completely. If this effect is not Destroyed by the end of the Event, the memories become permanent.

 The Elixir created by this Ritual expires at the end of the Event in which it was cast.

Title: Enhance Armour [Ritual]*
Name: Enhance Armour
Effect: This Ritual increases the Armour Points granted by the target suit of Physical Armour by two(2) for each casting. For every ten(10) additional points of armour, or portion thereof, this effect counts as one(1) effect towards the item's Ritual Effect Limit.

Title: Enhance Weapon [Ritual]*
Name: Enhance Weapon
Effect: This Ritual increases the base damage of the target weapon by one(1). Additional castings of this Ritual Effect in the same Concert increase the damage according to the following table. Castings Damage Bonus Ritual Slots 1 +1 1 3 +2 2 6 +3 3 10 +4 4 15 +5 5

Title: Exorcism [Ritual, Limited]
Name: Exorcism
Effect: This Ritual instantly removes any Spirits from the area and prevents any from entering the affected area for its duration.

Title: Extend Ritual [Ritual]
Name: Extend Ritual
Effect: When cast as the last Ritual in a Ritual Concert, this Ritual extends the duration of all valid Ritual effects in the current target Ritual Concert to one(1) year. This effect does not count towards the number of Ritual Effects on an Item.

Title: Extend Ritual, Greater [Ritual]
Name: Extend Ritual, Greater
Cost: P4 C2 T2 (Requires one P2 or P4)
Effect: When cast as the last Ritual in a Ritual Concert, this Ritual extends the duration of all valid Ritual effects in the current target Ritual Concert to two(2) years. This effect consumes one(1) of the item's Ritual effect slots.

Title: Extend Ritual, Superior [Ritual]
Name: Extend Ritual, Superior
Effect: When cast as the last Ritual in a Ritual Concert, this Ritual extends the duration of all valid Ritual effects in the current target Ritual Concert to five(5) years. This effect consumes two(2) of the Item's Ritual effect slots. This effect also requires a Special Component to be included.

Title: Funerary Rites [Ritual]
Name: Funerary Rites
Effect: This Ritual allows the Caster to summon the spirit of a permanently dead creature to the Circle. The maximum duration of this Ritual is five(5) minutes. The maximum number of years which can have elapsed since the target's death is ten(10) years. Each additional caster doubles the maximum number of years in this range.

Title: Grounded Armour [Ritual]*
Name: Grounded Armour
Effect: This Ritual imbues the target armour with the following ability. Once per Reset, the Item can negate a single effect delivered as Magic(-Strike). The Call for this ability is "Ward".

Title: Imbue Alchemy [Ritual]*
Name: Imbue Alchemy
Effect: As part of casting this Ritual the Caster chooses one(1) Alchemy they can cast from memory. This Ritual requires an amount of additional Power equal to one-third (1/3) the level of the Alchemy to be stored, rounded up. This Ritual imbues the ability to cast the chosen Alchemy into the target. The Caster cannot use their own Skills to modify the Alchemy in any way. The Character who is attuned to the item, or is the target of this effect, may cast the imbued Alchemy once per Reset. The call to use an Alchemy which is imbued is "Activate  <Delivery Verbal>". A Character cannot use their own Skills to modify an Alchemy which is cast using this effect.

Title: Imbue Skill [Ritual]*
Name: Imbue Skill
Effect:
As part of casting this Ritual the Caster chooses one Skill they possess. Only Skills which are usable "Once per Reset" can be Imbued. Alchemy Slots, Martial Arts Slots, Spell Slots, and Heritage Skills cannot be Imbued by this Ritual Effect. The same Skill can never be Imbued into a target more than once.

 The following Skills may be Imbued into an Item but require the Character to have at least one(1) Rank in the Skill in order to use the Imbued Skill. These Skills include; Create Cauldron, Create Flask, Create Potion, Create Scroll, Create Wand, Defensive Roll, Rune Carving, and Smithing.

 This Ritual requires an additional number of Power Components equal to one half the Skill Point cost, at Priority A, of the Skill to be stored rounded up. This Ritual imbues the ability to use the chosen Skill into the target. The Character who is attuned to the item, or is the target of this effect, may use the imbued skill once per Reset. The call to use a Skill which is imbued by this effect is "Activate <Skill Verbal>".

Title: Imbue Spell [Ritual]*
Name: Imbue Spell
Effect: As part of casting this Ritual the Caster chooses one Spell they can cast, with a Range other than Self, from memory. This Ritual requires an amount of additional Power equal to one third the level of the Spell to be stored rounded up. This Ritual imbues the ability to cast the chosen Spell into the target. The Caster cannot use their own Skills to modify the Spell in any way. The Character who is attuned to the item, or is the target of this effect, may cast the Imbued Spell once per Reset. The call to use a Spell which is Imbued by this effect "Activate <Incantation> <Delivery Verbal>". A Character cannot use their own Skills to modify a Spell which is cast using an item.

Title: Instil Chaos [Ritual]
Name: Instil Chaos
Effect:
This Ritual can only target a Ritual Concert of the appropriate type and must be the first Ritual performed in the Concert. This Ritual allows the Primary Caster to roll on the Random Flaw Table. For each additional Caster after the first, the Primary Caster gains one(1) charge of Chaos.

 After each Ritual in the Concert is cast, the Primary Caster rolls on the Flaw Table. They then have the option to expend one(1) or more Chaos to modify the result, increasing it, or decreasing it, by an equal amount. The Primary Caster is able to view the Flaw Table and their expected result.

 This Ritual cannot be cast more than once on a single Concert. Additionally, the Chaos available does not reset after each Ritual Casting. For example, The Ritual Concert begins with ten(10) Chaos. The Primary Caster rolls on the Flaw Table and chooses to change their result by three(3). Their amount of Chaos available for the rest of the Ritual Concert is now seven(7).

 Each Void Component used in the casting of a Ritual Concert targeted by this Ritual increases the amount of Chaos in the Ritual by one(1).

Title: Magic Weapon [Ritual]
Name: Magic Weapon
Effect: This Ritual imbues the target weapon with the following ability. Whenever a Weapon with this Ritual effect is used to deliver a Killing Blow, the wielder may deliver the Killing Blow as Magic allowing them to kill certain powerful creatures requiring magic weapons to kill.

Title: Modify Memory [Ritual, Limited]*
Name: Modify Memory
Effect:
This Ritual allows the Caster to modify a specific memory of the target. While this Ritual can, with permission of the target's Player, affect a more general memory, it normally is limited to a single hour which has occurred on the same Day in which this Ritual is cast. The Caster can choose one of the following three effects; Amnesia: The target forgets the target memory. Modified: The target remembers the memory slightly differently with persons or events being as described by the Caster. In this case the Caster must describe the altered memory in thirty(30) words or fewer. Fabricated: The memory is completely different. In this case the Caster must describe the new memory in twenty(20) words or fewer.

 This effect becomes permanent if it is not Destroyed before the end of the Event during which it was cast.

Title: Mortal Strike [Ritual]*
Name: Mortal Strike
Effect: This Ritual imbues the target weapon with the following ability. Once per Reset, the wielder of this Weapon may use it to deliver an attack causing "Physical-Strike Frailty".

Title: Neutralize [Ritual]
Name: Neutralize
Target: Ritual Alchemical Effect, Item or Creature
Effect: This Ritual Destroys all Ritual Alchemy in effect on the target as well as removing all effects delivered as Poison(-Strike) from the target.

Title: Penetrating Quiver  [Ritual]*
Name: Penetrating Quiver
Effect: This Ritual imbues the target weapon with the following ability. Once per Reset, the wielder of this weapon may use it to deliver a single Martial Art delivered by one, or more, Archery Packet(s), as Piercing.

Title: Phalanx Guard [Ritual]*
Name: Phalanx Guard
Effect:
This Ritual imbues the target Shield with the ability to, once per Reset, negate a single effect Delivered as <Effect>-Strike which strikes the Wielder. The call for this effect is "Activate Parry".

 This Ritual requires a number of additional Power Components based on the size of the Shield. A Gauntlet or Buckler requires one(1) additional Power, a Small Shield requires two(2) additional Power while a large Shield requires three(3) additional Power. If this Ritual is performed as a Smithing Ritual the Smith may substitute a Special Material Ingot; Adamantine, Iron or Silver, in place of the additional Power. For example if constructing a Small Shield the Smith could expend an Adamantine and Silver ingot in order to pay the addition two(2) Power needed to perform this Ritual on the target.

Title: Planar Attunement [Ritual]*
Name: Planar Attunement
Cost: P1 C1 + P1 per additional target
Target: The Caster and One additional target per additional Power Component expended.
Effect: This Ritual grants all targets Immunity to the harmful passive planar effects of the chosen plane. This effect cannot be extended and expires at the end of the Event. The maximum number of targets of this Ritual is equal to the twice number of Casters participating in the Ritual's casting.

Title: Planar Gate [Ritual, Limited]
Name: Planar Gate
Cost: P4 C3 E3 S3 T3 + Special
Effect: This Ritual causes the target Circle to become a gate to the target plane. This gate remains open for one(1) hour per Caster but can be closed early by any Caster touching it. Any creature travelling through the gate gains Planar Attunement to the plane they travel to.

Title: Planar Rift [Ritual]
Name: Planar Rift
Cost: P4 C2 E2 S2 + P1 per additional target
Target: The Caster and One additional target per additional power Component expended.
Effect:
This Ritual causes the targets to be transported to the target Extra-Plane for up to one(1) hour per Caster. The exact duration is chosen at the time of Casting the Ritual. Additionally, all targets gain the effects of Planar Attunement to the target plane. The maximum number of targets of this Ritual is equal to twice the number of Casters participating in the Ritual's casting.

 Casting this Ritual on a target under its effects causes the Ritual to immediately end returning the target to its home plane.

Title: Poison Reserve [Ritual]*
Name: Poison Reserve
Effect:
This Ritual grants the target item three(3) levels of Alchemy Store of the chosen school. An Alchemy Store item allows the holder to Absorb Alchemy which are Touch Cast on the Character holding the item. The Character with the Item may use the Item to cast the Stored Alchemy . Alchemy which is the target of one or more Mutations or Invocations cannot be Stored. The call for Absorbing Alchemy is "Absorb". The call for casting the stored Alchemy is "Activate: <Delivery Verbal>".

 Additional castings of this Ritual Effect in the same Concert increase the number of levels of Alchemy Store available to the item according to the following table. Castings Alchemy Store Levels Ritual Slots 1 3 1 3 6 2 6 9 3 10 12 4 15 15 5

Title: Prophecy [Ritual]
Name: Prophecy
Effect: This Ritual grants the Caster(s) a vision of events, usually the future, determined by local Staff.

Title: Protection Aura [Ritual]*
Name: Protection Aura
Effect: This Ritual imbues the target with the following ability. Once per Reset the Player may choose to activate this defence to negate a single effect as per the ability Perfect Ward. This ability cannot negate effects delivered as Arcane(-Strike). The call for this defence is "Ward".

Title: Protective Circle [Ritual]
Name: Protective Circle
Effect: This Ritual creates a Protective Circle. Anyone inside this Circle at the time of casting gains an investiture into it allowing them to enter or leave it at will as well allowing others to do so. Anyone inside the Circle is Immune to all effects which originate from outside of it. Creatures who are not Invested are incapable of entering the Circle unless a Character who is has allowed them access.

Title: Purifying Armour [Ritual]*
Name: Purifying Armour
Effect: This Ritual imbues the target armour or shield with the following ability. Once per Reset, the Item can negate a single effect with a duration other than instant. The call for this ability is "Ward".

Title: Purifying Weapon [Ritual]*
Name: Purifying Weapon
Effect: This Ritual imbues the target weapon with the following ability. Once per Reset, the weapon can be used to deliver a "Physical-Strike Vanquish Undead".

Title: Ranger Bond, Hunter [Ritual]*
Name: Ranger Bond, Hunter
Effect: This Ritual requires the target Suit of Leather Armour to include the front of the torso and at least four other areas. This effect grants the wearer of the Armour the ability to grant themselves a "Physical Ambush 5" or "Physical Vorpal 5" effect. This ability is usable at will, but the Character must Rest in between uses. Multiple casting of this Ritual Effect on a single target increases the number of times its effects may be used between Rests.

Title: Ranger Bond, Protector [Ritual]*
Name: Ranger Bond, Protector
Effect:
This Ritual requires the target Suit of Leather Armour to include the front of the torso and at least four other areas. This effect improves the value of each piece of the suit to that of Chainmail. If this Ritual is cast three(3) times on the same target, the value of each piece of the suit is increased to that of Plate.

 This Ritual takes up one(1) Ritual Effect slot if it is cast once and two(2) if it is cast thrice.

Title: Ranger Bond, Survivor [Ritual]
Name: Ranger Bond, Survivor
Effect: This Ritual requires the target Suit of Leather Armour to include the front of the torso and at least four other areas. The first time each Reset the Character Dies, they gain the effects of a "Contingency <Death>: Magic Life" effect.

Title: Recover Materials [Ritual, Limited]
Name: Recover Materials
Cost: P1 C1 D1 E1 S1 T1
Effect: This Ritual Destroys the magic upon the target effect refunding a prorated portion, rounded down, of the components used to create it. The amount refunded is based on the total number of components, divided by the duration, multiplied by the number of months left. For example, an item which required P12, C8, E10, S8, and T6 to create, with one year left of its two year duration would refund P6, C4, E5, S4, and T6. If the same item had only four months left it would refund P2, C1, E1, S1 and T1. The refunded components are issues in the form of a Component Voucher with the same expiry date as the original item.

Title: Reincarnate [Ritual]
Name: Reincarnate
Effect: This Ritual allows the target to choose a new People and Heritage for their Character. All Heritage Skills are refunded and new ones may be purchased immediately.

Title: Retribution [Ritual]
Name: Retribution
Effect: This Ritual empowers the target with a powerful form of magical vengeance. When the target is the victim of a Killing Blow the Player may choose to trigger this effect. If triggered, the killer is affected by "50 Arcane Body" plus twenty(20) additional Arcane Body damage for each additional Caster. This ability can be triggered once per Reset for every five(5) Casters, rounded up, who participated in its casting. A Character may have only one casting of Retribution on their Spirit and any new casting fails unless it is more powerful than the previous one.

Title: Sculpt Claw [Ritual]*
Name: Sculpt Claw
Effect: This Ritual causes the target's Natural Weapons, if any, to count as either an Axe, Sword, or Blunt Weapon. If cast a second time, on the same target, any Natural Weapon wielded by the target in their off-hand instead counts as either an Axe, Sword, or Blunt Weapon. Once this Ritual has been performed on the target they may benefit from Ritual effects which target that particular type of weapon. Without this Ritual effect a target is unable to benefit from the effects of any Rituals which target a specific type of weapon, such as Blood Drinker, but may still benefit from Rituals which target any type of weapon such as Enhance Weapon.

Title: Sending [Ritual]
Name: Sending
Effect: This Ritual allows the caster to send a message consisting of ten(10) words, plus one(1) additional word for per Caster, to the target.

Title: Severing Strike [Ritual]*
Name: Severing Strike
Effect: This Ritual imbues the target weapon with the following ability. Once per Reset, the wielder of this Weapon may use it to deliver an attack causing "Physical-Strike Cripple <Limb>".

Title: Shadow Duplication [Ritual]
Name: Shadow Duplication
Effect: This Ritual imbues the target weapon with the following ability. Whenever a weapon with this Ritual effect is thrown, the Character may throw one(1) additional Thrown Weapon, which must be identical to the weapon on which this Ritual is cast. Any creature struck by either Weapon is affected once by the attack. This additional weapon, and any others the Character may throw, must be thrown with the same hand and must be thrown at the same time.

Title: Spell Bond [Ritual]*
Name: Spell Bond
Effect:
This Ritual effect allows the Caster to choose a single Spell, with a Range of Packet that they can cast, as the Bonded Spell for this Ritual Effect. The Quiver functions similarly to a Spell Store Item, in that it allows the holder to Absorb a single copy of the Bonded Spell which is Touch Cast on the Character holding the Quiver. The Character with the Quiver may use the Quiver to cast the Stored Spell, delivering it as <Delivery Type>-Strike using an Archery Packet. Spells which are the target of one or more Spellshapes or Invocations cannot be Stored. The call for Absorbing Spells is "Absorb". The call for casting the stored Spells is "Activate: <Incantation> <Delivery Verbal>-Strike".

 Multiple casting of this Ritual may either use the same Spell, or a different Spell. Each casting of this Ritual consumes one of the item's Ritual Effect Slots.

Title: Spell Counter [Ritual]
Name: Spell Counter
Effect: This Ritual imbues the target weapon with the following ability. While wielding this weapon, the Character may also expend a use of the Counter Skill to Reflect any Weapon or Packet delivered effect delivered as Magic(-Strike). The call for this ability is "Reflect".

Title: Spell Eater [Ritual]*
Name: Spell Eater
Effect: This Ritual imbues the target weapon with the following ability.  Once per Reset, the wielder of this Weapon may use it to Absorb a single effect, delivered as Magic(-Strike), by which they are struck. Upon Absorbing this effect the Weapon may, until the end of Combat, be used to deliver Killing Blows as Magic. Alternatively the wielder may discharge this effect, losing the ability to deliver Killing Blows as Magic, to grant themselves the effects of a "Magic Vorpal 5". The call for this ability is "Absorbed".

Title: Spell Splinter [Ritual]*
Name: Spell Splinter
Effect: This Ritual imbues the target Quiver with the following ability. Once per Reset, the wielder of this Weapon may use it to deliver an attack causing a "Physical-Strike Remove Magic" effect. The Character must deliver this attack using Archery Packets but may throw, at once, any number of Packets.

Title: Spell Store [Ritual]*
Name: Spell Store
Effect:
This Ritual grants the target item three(3) levels of Spell Store. A Spell Store item allows the holder to Absorb Spells, other than those with a range of Self,  which are Touch Cast on the Character holding the item. The combined Level of all Spells stored within the item must be equal to, or less, than the number of levels of Spell Store the item possesses. The Character with the Item may use the Item to cast the Stored Spells. Spells which are the target of one or more Spellshapes or Invocations cannot be Stored. The call for Absorbing Spells is "Absorb". The call for casting the stored Spells is "Activate: <Incantation> <Delivery Verbal>".

 Additional castings of this Ritual Effect in the same Concert increase the number of levels of Spell Store available to the item according to the following table. Castings Spell Store Levels Ritual Slots 1 3 1 3 6 2 6 9 3 10 12 4 15 15 5

Title: Spell Strike [Ritual]*
Name: Spell Strike
Effect: This Ritual imbues the target weapon with the following ability. Once per Reset this weapon may be used to deliver a single Spell with a range of Packet from the Caster's memory as an <Effect>-Strike instead of its normal Delivery Type. The Delivery Type of the attack changes to match that of the Spell.

Title: Spellbreaker [Ritual]*
Name: Spellbreaker
Effect: This Ritual imbues the target weapon with the following ability. Once per Reset, the weapon can be used to deliver a "Physical-Strike Dispel Magic".

Title: Spiritbind Item [Ritual]*
Name: Spiritbind Item
Effect:
This Ritual binds the target item to the target creature. The item cannot be used or even carried by any other creature. All Spiritbound items must be marked with red either with a 1cm thick red band on the top or bottom of the grip, or be at least seventy- five(75)% red. Spiritbound items can be Conjured to the Character's possession any time the Player has access to a valid Physical Representation. A hold may not be called for the Player to retrieve the item. A Spiritbound item cannot be stolen, moved or used by any Character except the one to whom it is bound though it is acceptable for a Player to return the item directly to its owner.

 A Spirit may have multiple Items Spiritbound to them, but an Item cannot be Spiritbound to multiple Spirits.

Title: Splintering Strike [Ritual]*
Name: Splintering Strike
Effect: This Ritual imbues the target weapon with the following ability. Once per Reset, the wielder of this Weapon may use it to deliver an attack causing "Physical-Strike Destroy <Item or Construct>".

Title: Soul Cleave [Ritual]*
Name: Soul Cleave
Effect: This Ritual imbues the target weapon with the following ability. Once per Reset, the wielder of this Weapon may use it to deliver a "Magic-Strike Vanquish Spirit".

Title: Soul Forge [Ritual]
Name: Soul Forge
Effect: This Ritual allows the target to re-spend all Skill Points. This Ritual should be cast no more than once per year. Any casting beyond this limit doubles the number of components needed for each additional casting until the target goes one(1) year without being affected by this Ritual. This increase stacks each additional time the target is affected by this Ritual Effect. This means that if this Ritual is cast three times on the same target, the cost for a fourth casting would be eight(8) times the base Component cost.

Title: Stalker's Weapon [Ritual]*
Name: Stalker's Weapon
Effect: This Ritual increases the base damage of the target weapon by two(2) whenever the wielder is behind their target and able to see both of their shoulder blades. This bonus damage also applies any time the Character is under an effect which would allow them to use their damage bonus from Stealth Training. Additional castings of this Ritual Effect in the same Concert increase the damage according to the following table. Castings Damage Bonus Ritual Slots 1 +2 1 3 +4 2 6 +6 3 10 +8 4 15 +10 5

Title: Summon Creature [Ritual, Limited]
Name: Summon Creature
Effect:
This Ritual summons a creature of the type specified by the Scroll to perform one(1) or more services for the Primary Caster.

 The power and number of services performed by the creature is determined by the number of Casters participating in the casting. For every three(3) Casters participating, rounded down, the power or number of services may be increased by one(1) to a maximum of five(5) in either category. For example six Casters could increase the power to two(2) and the number of services to two(2). Alternatively they could increase the power to three(3) and have only the one(1) service provided by the base effect.

 A Service is a single finite task. The maximum time a Service can take is one(1) hour. Examples of valid Services are; "Follow and protect me on this adventure.", "Go to the town of Exampleton and tell me how many soldiers are there.", "Aid me with the casting of this Ritual.". Examples of invalid Services are; "Guard this area forever.", "Stay in this Circle and help us cast all our Rituals.", "Explore all the camps of the foreign military and bring me a list of all commanders.".

Title: Sunder Magic [Ritual]
Name: Sunder Magic
Effect:
This Ritual Destroys the magic upon the target. This Ritual cannot be cast on creatures or Items. This Ritual can only be cast within a Magic Circle created by the Create Magic Circle Ritual.

 The caster must be able to touch the effect during the casting. In the case of targeting a Sanctuary, the caster must be able to touch one of the doorways, or portal, into the targeted Sanctuary.

Title: Sword of Purity [Ritual]
Name: Sword of Purity
Effect: This Ritual imbues the target weapon with the following ability.  The Character may expend a use of the Counter Skill to Reflect any Weapon or Packet delivered Curse effect by which they are struck. The call for this ability is "Reflect".

Title: Talon Rake [Ritual]*
Name: Talon Rake
Effect: This Ritual effect grants the target Claw with the following effect. One per Reset, the Character may use the Claw to deliver an attack which causes Body Damage instead of its usual Weapon Type. This includes Martial Arts which normally cause Weapon Type damage as well as normal Weapon Damage attacks.

Title: Teleport Beacon [Ritual]
Name: Teleport Beacon
Effect: This Ritual creates in the target a Teleport Beacon allowing the Primary Caster to use the Spell Teleport to travel to the location of the target. It does not grant the Caster any special knowledge of the beacon's surroundings. If the holder or target of the beacon casts Teleport, the Caster may immediately cast Teleport to "follow" them to their destination. Except as explicitly stated above, this Ritual does not otherwise modify the Spell Teleport. This Ritual cannot be Extended.

Title: Teleportation Circle [Ritual]
Name: Teleportation Circle
Cost: P4 C1 S2 P1 per additional target. See text
Target: The Caster and One additional target per additional Power component
Effect:
The targets are transported to Town. All targets immediately go Out of Game and walk to the area designated as Town by Staff. Upon arrival, all targets appear at the edge of the area with the phrase "Magic Teleport".

 If the Caster has access to a Special Component provided by Plot, this Ritual effect can be used to travel to the location designated by the Special Component's effect.

 The maximum number of targets of this Ritual is equal to twice the number of Casters participating in the Ritual's casting.

Title: Thundering Strike [Ritual]*
Name: Thundering Strike
Effect: Once per Reset, the wielder of this Weapon may use it to deliver an attack causing "50 Physical- Strike <Weapon Type>". The Weapon Type of this effect is determined by the Weapon Type of the Weapon used to deliver the attack.

Title: Transmuting Weapon [Ritual]
Name: Transmuting Weapon
Effect: This Ritual imbues the target item with the following ability. The wielder of the target weapon to change its Weapon Type to any of the following; Normal, Iron, or Silver. The process of changing Weapon Types takes one(1) minute, but can be done at will. If the item is under a Ritual effect which only affects weapons made of a Special Material, the effect cannot be used unless the weapon is the corresponding type. Any effects which are suppressed still count against the number of Ritual Effects on the target item.

Title: Turning [Ritual]*
Name: Turning
Effect: This Ritual imbues the target with the following ability. At the time of casting this Ritual the Caster chooses one of the following effects; Acid, Binding, Charms, Curse, Fire, Ice, Lightning, Break/Destroy, or Stone. Once per Reset, at the time of the player's choosing, the effect is Reflected back against the attacker. Should the attack be reflected again it is negated by the Ward effect. The Call for this ability is "Reflect".

Title: Unmake [Ritual]
Name: Unmake
Target: Ritual Smithing Effect, Item or Creature
Effect: This Ritual Destroys all Ritual Smithing in effect upon the target.

Title: Unstoppable Strike [Ritual]*
Name: Unstoppable Strike
Effect: This Ritual imbues the target weapon with the following ability. Once per Reset, the wielder of this Weapon may use it to deliver a <Effect>-Strike as Piercing. This ability can be used on Spells, Martial Arts, Alchemy and regular Skills.

Title: Unravelling Weapon [Ritual]*
Name: Unravelling Weapon
Effect: This Ritual imbues the target weapon with the following ability. Once per Reset, the wielder of this Weapon may use it to deliver a "Physical-Strike Vanquish Fae".

Title: Unyielding Armour [Ritual]*
Name: Unyielding Armour
Effect: This Ritual imbues the target Armour or Shield with the following ability. Once per Reset, the Item can negate a single attack causing Weapon Damage or a single effect delivered as Physical(-Strike). The call for this ability is "Ward".

Title: Veil of the Hunter [Ritual, Limited]*
Name: Veil of the Hunter
Effect:
Once cast, all targets gain the benefits of the Hunter's Veil specified by the scroll. Eg:	 Spider Hunter's Veil: Targets gain: Escape from Binding on 3-Count. Reduce damage from Poison by half. Poison Resistance

 Vampire Hunter's Veil: Targets gain: Immunity to Vampire Charms, Vampirism and Create Undead.

Title: Venom Ward [Ritual]*
Name: Venom Ward
Effect: This Ritual imbues the target with the following ability. Once per Reset, the Character, or wielder of the item, may negate a single effect delivered as Poison(-Strike). The call for this ability is "Ward".

Title: Vorpal Weapon [Ritual]*
Name: Vorpal Weapon
Effect: This Ritual imbues the target weapon with the following ability. Once per Reset, the weapon can be used to deliver an attack causing "50 Physical-Strike Normal" damage.

Title: Warding [Ritual]*
Name: Warding
Effect: Choose one of the following effects; Acid, Binding, Compulsion, Curse, Fire, Ice, Lightning, Break/Destroy, or Stone. Once per Reset the player may choose to activate this defence negating the effect. The call for this ability is "Ward".

Title: Word of Recall [Ritual]*
Name: Word of Recall
Cost: P4 C1 S1 T1 + P1 per additional target
Target: Circle and The Caster and One additional target per component
Effect: As part of casting this Ritual the Caster chooses a word. The target Circle becomes the Destination. At any time during the event a target may speak the chosen word. They will immediately gain the benefits of a Magic Teleport to the Circle in which this Ritual was cast. Though the Character can use this ability while under an effect that would keep them from using Skills, they must be able to speak to trigger this effect. This effect cannot be Extended and ends with the Event during which it was cast. Upon arrival, all targets appear at the edge of the area with the phrase "Magic Teleport". This effect ends once it has been triggered.
